projectContext: Psytrance festival portal. Dark cosmic aesthetic — think Ozora Festival at night. Outdoor events, nature, fire and neon under dark sky. NOT cold Berlin techno, NOT EDM clubs. Colors: #0a0a0a background, #1a1a1a surfaces, cyan #22d3ee, purple #a855f7, magenta #ec4899 accents. Fonts: Orbitron for headings, Inter for body. The site has a persistent bottom audio player — never obscure it.

references.description: Current site — study the visual identity, especially the Goa transition section with warm oranges and earthy tones
